necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
